invocation: claude -p "say the literal word hi and nothing else" --output-format stream-json --verbose --max-turns 1
exercises: Full stream-json event sequence: system/init, assistant message, result
All cleanup sequences claude emits on exit:
CSI ?2031l                       — disable color-scheme change notifications (contour ext)
ESC 7 / ESC [r / ESC 8           — DEC save/restore + reset scroll region
notes: Critical fixture for engine OSC handling. Claude assumes Kitty keyboard, focus reporting, iTerm2 progress, bracketed paste, contour color-scheme — missing any = visible garbage on exit. This file is the canonical reference for our cleanup sequence parser.
